зато.gloss: but on the other hand, to make up for it

meanings.en: but on the other hand, at least
meanings.note: introduces a compensating positive fact

examples.trans: A four in algebra, but a five in gym.
The flat is small, but at least it's in the centre.

examples.text: Ничего страшного. Сейчас зато аппетит нагуляем.
examples.trans: No big deal. At least we'll walk up an appetite now.

meanings.note: Parenthetical. Core Russian adv meaning 'so, then, that means' in everyday speech.
verb: Что это значит? = What does it mean?

examples.trans: So you're not coming?

meanings.note: Adjective formed with the common Slavic suffix '-н-' from a noun/verb root. Agrees in gender, number, and case with the noun it modifies ('creative').

meanings.note: Motion in one direction. Used as an imperfective (ongoing/repeated action) verb meaning 'to fly (in one direction)', paired with 'полететь'.

meanings.note: + genitive. Core Russian prep meaning 'at, by; (у меня) I have' in everyday speech.
